welcome_message:
Welcome to the SmartStudentBot for Perugia! 🇮🇹

Please select your language to continue:
info_questura_perugia: Police Headquarters (Questura - for Permit of Stay)
weather_error: Sorry, I couldn't fetch the weather information for {city_name}. Please try again later.
weather_city_not_found: Sorry, I could not find the city '{city_name}'. Please check the spelling.
isee_intro:
Let's calculate an estimate of your ISEE for scholarship purposes.
Please note, this is an unofficial estimate. You must get an official ISEE Parificato.
isee_ask_income: 1️⃣ What is your family's total annual income in Euro? (e.g., 15000)
isee_ask_property: 2️⃣ What is the total square meterage of property owned by your family? (e.g., 80)
isee_ask_family_members: 3️⃣ How many members are in your family (including yourself)?
isee_invalid_input: Invalid input. Please enter a valid number.
isee_family_coefficient_error: Invalid family size. Please enter a number between 1 and 10.
live_chat_start: You are requesting a live chat with an admin. Please wait while we connect you.
live_chat_no_admins: Sorry, no admins are available at the moment. Please try again later.
live_chat_request_to_admins: A user is requesting a live chat. Please accept if you are available.
live_chat_connected_user: An admin has connected. You can now send your messages. Type /end_chat to finish.
live_chat_connected_admin: You are now connected to the user. Type /end_chat to finish.
live_chat_ended_by_user: The user has ended the chat session.
live_chat_ended_by_admin: The admin has ended the chat session.
live_chat_self_ended: You have ended the chat session.
post_news_start: Let's post a new article. What is the title?
post_news_ask_content: Great title! Now, please send the main content (text). You can also attach a photo or document in the next step.
post_news_ask_media: Content received. Would you like to add a photo, video, or document? If so, send it now. Otherwise, type /skip.
post_news_ask_caption: Media received. Please provide a short caption for the post.
post_news_confirm: News article created and is ready to be published. Title: {title}
post_news_no_permission: You do not have permission to post news.
